sentences.text: The petitioners are claiming compensation at the rate of Rs.120 per sq. yd. in terms of order of the Reference Court dated 25.03.2022 in Land Acquisition Reference No.326 of 1991 in relation to the co-tenure holders.
Their representation dated 16.08.2023, filed in this behalf, is pending.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents be directed to decide the same,
to which Shri Nipun Singh, learned counsel for the U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad has no objection.
